analysis_name: U2 repeated-split selection-stability and simplification audit
analysis_status: post-U1 secondary analysis; original Step-22-R primary results unchanged

branches.rule: choose the eligible family with largest median Top-5 absolute Hedges g; break exact ties by frozen family priority
use absolute deviation if at least five coordinates pass the unchanged gate; otherwise abstain
choose between eligible signed level and absolute deviation using the unchanged family score and tie rule

candidate_gate: bootstrap 95% CI excludes zero AND within-fault BH q<=0.05 across 260 candidates AND permutation max-|t| FWER-adjusted p<=0.05
control_limit_rule: 95th percentile of repeat-specific normal-development run maxima
family_choice_rule: largest median selected absolute Hedges g with frozen priority tie-break
family_eligibility: at least five coordinates pass the unchanged dual gate
fixed_signed_level_reason: U1 already established 3/17 abstentions and materially inferior performance; retained as U1 applicability control
inference_boundary: internal post-freeze repeated-split stability on reused benchmark runs; original final/evaluation runs can enter development roles in secondary repeats, so this is not a new holdout, external validation, independent process replication, or prospective comparison
interpretation_rule: U1 must be reported; U2 tests whether added family flexibility increases selection variance without held-out benefit. No branch may be promoted to a new primary analysis post hoc.
multiplicity_scope: within each fault across the fixed 5 x 52 candidate universe
performance_endpoints: all-run penalized median and mean delay
selection_seed_rule: SELECTION_SEED_BASE + repeat*1000000; Step-19 adds fault-specific offsets
selection_stability_endpoints: family recovery versus original frozen branch
